member.name: T:Cinora.Domain.ValueObjects.NotificationPreferences
member.summary:
A user's per-type Web Push opt-out preferences (Milestone 6.3, ADR 0020 §4 / un-defers ADR 0015). A pure, immutable value object owned by — four booleans, one per , each default (opt-out semantics: a subscriber receives push for every type until they mute one). It carries no persistence concern; the EF owned-type mapping lives in Infrastructure.
Scope is deliberately push only: the in-app inbox row and the SignalR live toast are always delivered (the inbox is the authoritative source of truth, ADR 0011); only the out-of-app push fan-out consults . A future email / in-app-mute channel would migrate to a per-(UserId, Channel, Type) entity (recorded in ADR 0020, not built).
